The exact threshold is for uniform reconstruction over all qualifying inputs of a common width, not a claim that every individual input requires nine observations or that no smaller-width/subclass result is possible.

The module proves reconstruction thresholds only. It adds no claim about eventual palindromes, all-time safety, initial-integer injectivity, different initial widths, or solving the 196 problem.
